report: Updated `src/workflow.py` so editor edits use the existing per-visit 120 ms trailing task instead of writing per keystroke. Pending editor text is flushed before a visit retires (close, replacement open, dispose) and before submission, preserving persisted reopening and submission snapshots. Search preview behavior was unchanged. Validated with a local synchronous timer/store harness covering burst coalescing, later bursts, open replacement, submit, and dispose; all checks passed.
